newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brass mill output rises 1.8 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Japan brass mill output rises 1.8 pct in January.

text.p: Japan's brass mill output in January rose 1.8 percent from the same month a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted 104,242 tonnes, according to preliminary data released Thursday by the Japan Brass Makers' Association.
It was the fourth month in a row in which output had risen year-on-year, following a 13-month streak of declines.
The association released preliminary January data for output only. It also released final data for December, as follows (in tonnes):
*(NOTE: December output figure revised, seasonally adjusted.)

The December data showed that shipments to the semiconductor sector rose from year-ago levels, after declining for much of the year, while the remainder of the electronics sector also recorded moderate to strong growth. Shipments to the automotive and air conditioning/refrigeration sectors recorded modest year-on-year increases.
